name: Keshu & Billy // Ngoundere
text: Nic and his team were amazing. They were easy to work with and understood the vision we wanted for our wedding pictures. I will definitely work with them again and recommend their services.

name: Stephanie // Yaounde
text: J’ai ouvert toutes les photos et je tenais à vous dire que ce sont vos meilleures photos. Je ne sais pas si c’est la nuit mais c’est un travail excellent. Et votre collaborateur là est très fort. Il a su placer les gens 👌🏽

name: Cynthia and Prince
text: Chap Nic and his team were amazing. They were very professional, creative, patient and easy to work with. They were able to capture special moments of our day in the most beautiful way and the pictures came out perfectly. We would definitely recommend them.

name: Tatianne and Vander
text: He’s the best photographer and the most amazing quality he has is that he’s very patient and captures the moment, I love every moment working with you
